_comment: CSA tenant. enabledModules is an explicit subset — 'autocorr' (auto-correlation) + 'market-radar' (competitor media spend estimator). Both run on the same minimal backend (gateway+agents+mcp-stats+frontend, no mcp-toolbox); ENABLED_AGENTS = session_naming_agent + autocorr_assistant_agent + the competitive agents; FloatingAssistant off.
_branding: Vivid red ramp anchored on the Converged.AI brand red (#e50914). To retune: edit accent + run `node scripts/gen-tenant-config.mjs`. onDark/onLight = the readable accent text colour per theme. (Surfaces/fonts are the shared theme; ask to extend branding to override those too.)

branding.tagline: Competitive media intelligence — estimate spend, share of voice, and correlate what moves your KPIs.
